items.name: Orbital Ring
items.desc: This Starbase variant encircles the planet, providing space for Modules, Buildings, and Defense Platforms.

items.name: Private Colony Ship
items.desc: Private Colony Ships are funded by unknown actors from the private sector. As a result the colonists may have ethics differing from the majority.

items.name: Genesis Ark
items.desc: The specialized colony ship facilitates the genesis of pre-sapient species by selecting the most promising candidates and setting up the initial colony for our overseers.

items.name: Space Amoeba
items.desc: Space Amoeba are lone predators, aggressive towards anything they encounter. Supported by partially-formed spawn known as "flagella", these creatures are adept at chasing down their prey.

items.name: Habitat Central Complex
items.desc: The central orbital of a §YHabitat Complex§!, capable of housing several £pop£ §HPops§! and providing space for £building£ §YBuildings§! and £district£ §YDistricts§! in orbit of uninhabitable planets.
